## Benzinga Viewer Survey: 64% Have Owned Apple Stock, Current Ownership Rate Is Lower

Retail positioning surveys for mega-cap names carry limited institutional weight but can serve as a rough sentiment baseline; a declining ownership rate among retail viewers, if confirmed, could indicate some retail fatigue with AAPL at current levels.

- A Benzinga retail survey found 64% of respondents have owned Apple (AAPL) at some point.
- The framing implies current ownership is below that historical penetration level.
- This is a retail sentiment data point with no fundamental or institutional signal.
